topic: Extrusion equipment cost for a 1 t/h line
claim_a: Part I (app-i I16, plays.csv T1): equipment USD 1.5 to 4.0 M, an assumption with no verified quote
claim_b: Chinese marketplace listings: USD 11,000 to 100,000 per set for 0.5 to 1.5 t/h dry TVP lines with dryer (TIC-02; TIC-03; TIC-07; TIC-10)
position_taken: Use a Chinese-equipped installed capex of USD 0.28 to 1.38 M (our build-up) as the base case and keep USD 2.0 to 5.6 M for a European-grade line as a sensitivity; do not average
notes: Both sides are Low: one is an assumption, the other listing prices

claim_a: app-i I16 and ch09.4: 3,000 t a year on one 1 t/h line
claim_b: ch28.6: each 1 t/h line needs about 7,000 t a year
position_taken: State hours: 3,000 t is 37.5% of 8,000 h; 7,000 t is about 88%; use 4,000 to 7,200 t (50 to 90%)

topic: TPP-01 price per kg of protein
claim_a: TPP-01: USD 1.24 per kg FOB plus freight and 5% duty is about USD 1.9 per kg of protein
claim_b: Arithmetic: 1.24 / 0.65 = 1.91 is the FOB value only; landed 1.29 to 1.44 per kg gives 1.98 to 2.22 per kg of protein at 65% (2.35 to 2.62 at 55%)
position_taken: Correct TPP-01 to the landed range
notes: Our calculation from BUY-02 and TIC-12

topic: Price of food-grade defatted soy flour
claim_a: Part I: USD 550 per t (soybean meal USD 404 plus about USD 150 food premium)
claim_b: UN Comtrade 2025: China soybean meal to Vietnam USD 604 per t FOB (grade unknown); India and Netherlands soy flour USD 783 to 896 per t FOB (TIC-12; TIC-13)
position_taken: Use USD 627 to 925 per t delivered; the Part I low end looks low
notes: Grade (low-temperature, NSI) and GMO status unverified in all anchors

claim_a: Gluten 2023: Vietnam CIF import value from China is 1.03 times China FOB export value
claim_b: HS 2106.10 2023: Vietnam CIF value from China is 0.72 times China FOB value
position_taken: Do not infer freight from 2106.10 mirror data; assume 3 to 8% freight and insurance
notes: Vietnam 2023 quantities are estimated by UN Comtrade; classification differences likely (TIC-16)

topic: Growth of the imports T1 would replace
claim_a: ch29.3: plant-protein imports from China nearly tripled (18,375 t in 2019 to 53,976 t in 2025, three HS codes)
claim_b: China-origin HS 2106.10 grew from 6,615 t to 10,201 t (54%); the tripling is mostly HS 3504 at about USD 1 per kg, likely feed
position_taken: Cite 2106.10 growth for T1; keep the three-code figure for the whole ingredient pool

topic: Pool a soy extrusion line can serve
claim_a: ch28.2 R1: about 40,000 t of food plant-protein ingredient imports (2106.10, 3504 and 1109)
claim_b: Textured-type 2106.10 from China, India and Serbia: 12,832 t in 2025 (all uses); gluten and isolates need other plants
position_taken: Size T1 on about 12,800 t; keep 40,000 t for route R1 as a whole

claim_a: app-i I11: plant-based meat by freeze alignment (Thailand)
claim_b: Publisher page: 100 t a year plant modelled with Japanese wages; TCI USD 1.76 to 2.48 M; minimum selling price USD 1.18 per 100 g
position_taken: Treat it as a Japanese-site model; not comparable with extrusion
notes: COST-56 read via the publisher page summary only (Low to Medium)

topic: Processing spread of textured protein over flour
claim_a: China 2025: textured protein USD 1,237 per t against soybean meal USD 604 per t to Vietnam, a spread of about USD 630 (TIC-12)
claim_b: India 2025: textured protein to Vietnam USD 980 per t against soy flour exports at USD 783 to 802 per t, a spread of about USD 180 to 200 (BUY-02; TIC-13)
position_taken: Unresolved; the grades probably differ; the Chinese spread is the one a Vietnamese line competes inside
